exposure: Women that attended either private  or public-led obstetric  antenatal care were more likely to have epidural analgesia in labor.
Women attending the community midwives were least likely to receive epidural analgesia during labor.
Primiparous women were more likely to use non-pharmacological methods of pain relief.
Type of antenatal care (private, public-led obstetric, community midwife)
cohort: 809 women who gave birth in a large tertiary maternity hospital in Ireland
finding: The Labour Hopscotch Framework, which encourages active labor, was found to be useful by women, with mobilizing, birthing ball, birthing stool, and water therapy being the most helpful steps, and was associated with high rates of spontaneous vaginal birth.
